nodes.label: deportes.jpg — Sports Equipment Hero Image
nodes.description: Promotional/hero image showing a collection of sports balls and equipment arranged together on a white background. Visible items: orange basketball, blue-and-yellow volleyball, brown American football, black-and-white soccer ball (fútbol), yellow-green tennis balls with a tennis racket, and a baseball with a wooden bat. Purpose: system asset for the DeporteParaTodos Angular frontend to visually represent the multi-sport platform concept. Used as a generic sports/athletics illustration (e.g., home page banner, category header, or placeholder image for sports categories).
nodes.design_purpose: Hero / decorative image representing multi-sport activities for the DeporteParaTodos sports management application

nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (Logo_Unicauca2.png)
nodes.description: Official institutional logo/crest of the Universidad del Cauca (University of Cauca, Colombia). Features a heraldic shield with a hand holding a torch/flame at center, ornate scroll-work surround, a banner with Latin motto 'POST TENEBRAS LUX MORITURI', founding year '1827' inscribed at the bottom, and 'UNIVERSIDAD DEL CAUCA' text. Rendered in grayscale/black-and-white line art style. Used as a branding asset in the DeporteParaTodos frontend application.
nodes.purpose: Institutional branding — university identity logo displayed in the application UI
visual_elements: torch with flame held by a hand
Latin motto banner: POST TENEBRAS LUX MORITURI

nodes.label: Alert.gif — Warning/Alert Icon
nodes.description: Animated GIF depicting a classic red-bordered warning triangle (road-sign style) with a white interior and a bold black exclamation mark. Used as a system-level alert or warning indicator icon within the Angular application UI.

nodes.label: catDeportes.jpg — Sports Categories Hero Image
nodes.description: Flat-lay photograph of multiple sports equipment items arranged in a circle on green grass. Items visible: soccer ball, basketball, volleyball, rugby/American football, tennis racket, badminton racket, table-tennis (ping-pong) paddles, baseball glove, baseball bat, tennis balls, shuttlecock, jump rope, athletic sneakers, and a red water bottle. The composition creates a visually rich, colourful collage representing the variety of sports offered by the DeporteParaTodos platform. Used as a generic sports-category banner or placeholder image throughout the Angular application (e.g. HomeComponent category cards and CursosDeportivosComponent).
nodes.design_purpose: Hero/banner image for the sports-categories section of the DeporteParaTodos frontend. Communicates multi-sport scope at a glance without text.

nodes.label: deporte.jpg — Soccer/Football action photo (system asset)
nodes.description: Dynamic sports photography showing two soccer/football players mid-air competing for a ball. One player wears a blue jersey, the other white. The scene is shot against a dark stadium background with bokeh lighting effects, conveying athleticism and competitive intensity. Used as a system image asset in the DeporteParaTodos frontend application, likely for decorative or illustrative purposes on sport-related pages.
nodes.design_purpose: Hero or background image for a sports management platform; communicates the athletic and competitive theme of the DeporteParaTodos application
visual_elements: two male soccer players in mid-air action
soccer ball in the air between players
white jersey player on right (performing bicycle-kick style move)
dark stadium background with blurred bokeh lights

nodes.label: Universidad del Cauca Logo
nodes.description: Institutional logo of Universidad del Cauca. Contains the university's heraldic shield/coat of arms on the left (featuring ornate decorative border and central emblem) and the text 'Universidad del Cauca' in two lines on the right. Light gray/white color scheme, used as a branding asset in the DeporteParaTodos frontend application (likely in login or header area to identify the institution).

nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (horizontal, variant B — white/light version)
nodes.description: Official horizontal logo of Universidad del Cauca in its 'B' (white/inverted) variant. The logo renders white-on-transparent, making it suitable for use on dark or coloured backgrounds. It is stored as a static branding asset in the Angular frontend application (DeporteParaTodos) under src/assets/imagesSystem/.
nodes.norm_label: logo universidad del cauca (horizontal, variant b — white/light version)
nodes.purpose: Institutional branding asset — university identity mark used in the application UI (likely in header, login screen, or footer).

nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (vertical)
nodes.description: Official vertical institutional logo of Universidad del Cauca. Features the university coat of arms (heraldic shield with ornate baroque flourishes) showing a hand holding a flaming torch, surrounded by the Latin motto 'POSTERIS LVMEN MORITVRVS EDAT'. Below the shield is a ribbon banner inscribed '1827 UNIVERSIDAD DEL CAUCA' (founding year). The wordmark 'Universidad del Cauca' appears in large bold blue serif typography beneath the crest. Color scheme: deep royal blue on white background. Used as a branding/identity asset in the DeporteParaTodos Angular frontend application.

nodes.label: portada.jpg — Sports Training Cover Image
nodes.description: Cover/hero image for the DeporteParaTodos sports management application. Shows an outdoor athletic track (red rubberized surface) with three young athletes (students) running/training in black athletic clothing, observed by an instructor/coach standing to the right holding papers/clipboard. Hurdles are visible on the left side of the track. The scene communicates athletic training, coaching supervision, and institutional sports practice — directly reflecting the application's core domain of managing sports courses, groups of athletes (alumnos), and instructors.
nodes.design_purpose: Hero/cover image for the application landing page or marketing material; establishes sports/athletics brand identity for the platform
visual_elements: Three student athletes running in black uniforms
Outdoor stadium setting with bleachers visible in background

nodes.label: Silueta (Default User Avatar)
nodes.description: A dark silhouette of a person (male figure, head and shoulders) against a plain white background. This is a generic placeholder/default avatar image used in the application's user profile system when no profile photo is available. The silhouette is entirely black/very dark, showing no facial features, serving as an anonymous stand-in for user profile pictures.
nodes.design_purpose: Default avatar / fallback profile image for users who have not uploaded a personal photo. Commonly displayed in profile cards, headers, and user listings when the real user image is absent.
visual_elements: Solid dark/black fill with no facial detail
Neutral, gender-ambiguous but slightly male-presenting shape

nodes.label: BehaviorSubject State Management Pattern
nodes.rationale: Chosen over NgRx/external store to keep state management simple; PerfilService exposes active profile as BehaviorSubject subscribed in ngOnInit and unsubscribed in ngOnDestroy
